messages:
maria: quick heads-up — in prod console just saw a saved-search from org B while previewing as org A. :eyes:
aj: whoa, steps?
maria: switch org dropdown -> pick org A -> open saved searches panel -> click preview on a run -> panel shows results and title from org B
sasha: can you repro consistently? or one-off?
maria: repro 3/3 on my env in us-west1, clearing browser cache doesn't help. incognito same.
kevin: possibly sticky session token on the preview iframe? we recently changed route affinity to use 'x-console-session' header for batching, maybe header reuse across quick-switch race
sasha: that header is supposed to be per-tenant. if the route affinity cache key omitted org id, it could hand back a session for a different org when switching fast
aj: @kevin can you check gateway logs for request-id 4765432100-1 (i've got raw capture) — look for x-console-session / x-org-id pairs
kevin: looking... saw two requests 4765432100-1 and 4765432100-2 within 120ms. both used same x-console-session=cs_7f9 and different x-org-id. gateway returned 200 for both, backend pulled cached session cs_7f9 bound to org B
maria: minimal repro script in case helpful:
```
# repro script (curl)
curl -H "x-console-session: cs_7f9" -H "x-org-id: org-a" https://console.internal/api/preview/run/123
curl -H "x-console-session: cs_7f9" -H "x-org-id: org-b" https://console.internal/api/preview/run/456
```\nkevin: that matches. cache key currently is just session id. fixing to include org id and user id. will push hotfix to staging first
sasha: suggest rollback of the quick-switch rollout for the console preview feature until fix is verified. this is a data isolation surface — high risk
aj: agreed. who owns the rollout?
kevin: i triggered the rollout yesterday. rolling back now. deploy-bot: Rolling back console-preview v2026.03.19 -> v2026.03.17 (started) :robot_face:
deploy-bot: Rollback complete, 3/3 pods replaced.
maria: thanks. can we also add an eval that fuzzes rapid org switches + preview requests? I'd like an alert if cross-org content appears in preview for any tenant
sasha: created issue ENG-4902, assigned to kevin, tag: P0-multi-tenant-isolation. I'd also add a telemetry metric for 'preview_org_mismatch' that increments when response org != request org
aj: good call. kevin, please add a short-term test and ping QA for a canary. thx everyone :thumbsup:
kevin: on it. ETA 2 hours for staging patch and smoke tests
maria: leaving logs/console capture in #incidents if anyone wants to look later
kevin: will follow up with patch PR and rollout plan in the thread here
